description: Attorney GiGi Hayes is running for Alabama House of Representatives District 52 because our communities deserve leadership that listens, shows up, and delivers real results. With a proven record as an attorney, educator, and community advocate, GiGi is committed to building safe neighborhoods, strong schools, and real economic opportunity for families across Jefferson County.
